unresolved.message: GET /v1/orders is joined to api GET /${…}v1/orders by taking the part of its address read from API_CONTEXT_PATH as empty, as every committed environment file of api leaves it
unresolved.hint: The part is where a deployment mounts the service. One that sets API_CONTEXT_PATH serves every route behind it, and this join is then wrong, so it is weaker than a join read in full.

unresolved.message: GET /v1/orders/:param is joined to api GET /${…}v1/orders/:param by taking the part of its address read from API_CONTEXT_PATH as empty, as every committed environment file of api leaves it
unresolved.hint: The part is where a deployment mounts the service. One that sets API_CONTEXT_PATH serves every route behind it, and this join is then wrong, so it is weaker than a join read in full.
Add the service that answers it to services[], or annotate the method with /** @flowatlas-calls GET /v1/invoices */.
